rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for the bird.

example.english: I keep a parrot at home.
example.jyutping: ngo5 uk1 kei2 joeng5 zo2 zek3 jing1 mou5

rows.note: Use this for a person who merely echoes another person's words or views, especially in a yes-man sense.

example.english: Don't always be a parrot; think for yourself first.
example.traditional: 你唔好成日做應聲蟲，自己諗下先啦。
example.jyutping: nei5 m4 hou2 seng4 jat6 zou6 jing3 sing1 cung4 zi6 gei2 nam2 haa5 sin1 laa1
